src/ts/components/Link.tsx.description: Navigation link that updates the URL in-page (no reload) and marks itself active

href.description: Target URL. Same-origin targets navigate in-page without a reload

replace.description: Replace the current history entry instead of adding one. Default false

match.description: "exact" matches the pathname, "prefix" also matches sub-paths (href "/" only matches "/"). Default "prefix"

target.description: Anchor target, e.g. "_blank". Targets other than "_self" are left to the browser

id.description: Unique ID to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

loading_state.description: Object that holds the loading state object coming from dash-renderer. For use with dash<3.

type.name: shape

is_loading.description: Determines if the component is loading or not
is_loading.name: bool

component_name.description: Holds the name of the component that is loading
component_name.name: string

type.raw: { is_loading: boolean; prop_name: string; component_name: string; }

src/ts/components/UrlCommit.tsx.description: Writes a group of deferred UrlParam values (and/or fixed parameters) to the URL when its child fires

children.description: A single component that commits, e.g. an apply button

group.description: Group of UrlParam components (`group=...`) that is written to the URL. Without a group only `setParams` / `clear` are applied

prop.description: Prop of the child that triggers the commit when it changes. Default "n_clicks"

setParams.description: Parameters written on commit. With a group only if at least one of its parameters has a value (otherwise they are removed)

history.description: "push" adds a browser history entry, "replace" does not. Default "push"

id.description: Unique ID to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

loading_state.description: Object that holds the loading state object coming from dash-renderer. For use with dash<3.

type.name: shape

is_loading.description: Determines if the component is loading or not
is_loading.name: bool

component_name.description: Holds the name of the component that is loading
component_name.name: string

type.raw: { is_loading: boolean; prop_name: string; component_name: string; }

src/ts/components/UrlParam.tsx.description: Syncs one prop of its child with a URL query parameter, without callbacks

children.description: A single component whose prop is synced with the URL

param.description: Name of the URL query parameter

prop.description: Prop of the child that is synced. Default "value"

format.description: How the value is written to the URL: lists comma separated, "json" for objects. "auto" infers it from the child's value. Default "auto"

clear.description: Query parameters removed whenever this parameter is written (e.g. ["page"])

default.description: Value the parameter stands for when it is missing from the URL; it is left out of the URL while the child has it. Defaults to the value the layout renders when the URL has no such parameter

history.description: "push" adds a browser history entry, "replace" does not. Default "push"

debounce.description: Wait this many milliseconds after the last change before writing the URL. Default 0

twoWay.description: Also follow later URL changes (back/forward, other parameters clearing this one). Default false

group.description: Defer the write until the group is committed by a UrlCommit (or `commitOn`)

commitOn.description: Prop of the child that commits the group when it changes, e.g. "n_submit"

setParams.description: Parameters written on a commit triggered via `commitOn`, only if the group has a value

id.description: Unique ID to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

loading_state.description: Object that holds the loading state object coming from dash-renderer. For use with dash<3.

type.name: shape

is_loading.description: Determines if the component is loading or not
is_loading.name: bool

component_name.description: Holds the name of the component that is loading
component_name.name: string

type.raw: { is_loading: boolean; prop_name: string; component_name: string; }

src/ts/components/UrlSegment.tsx.description: Syncs one prop of its child with a URL path segment, e.g. the active tab of `/orders/1003/<tab>`

children.description: A single component whose prop is synced with a URL path segment

base.description: Browser path of the parent, without trailing slash, e.g. "/orders/1003" ("" for the root)

prop.description: Prop of the child that is synced. Default "value"

default.description: Segment the bare `base` URL stands for; selecting it writes `base` without the segment

history.description: "push" adds a browser history entry, "replace" does not. Default "push"

keepQuery.description: Keep the query string when the segment is written. Default true
